intro: The ground is below the launch point.

widget.instructions: Press Play to watch the ball rise and fall past the cliff.

args.text: Watch the whole flight: up, back past the cliff top, and down to the foot.

stem: A ball is thrown straight up at {{u}} m/s from the edge of a cliff {{h}} m high. It just misses the edge on the way down and lands at the foot. Take g = 9.8 m/s².
How long after the throw does it land?

hints.text: Take up as positive with the origin at the cliff top. Where is the ground?
Solve −{{h}} = {{u}}t − ½ × 9.8 × t² for the positive root.

ignores-launch-height.text: That is when it returns to the cliff top. It still has {{h}} m to fall.

ignores-throw.text: That would be the time if the ball were simply dropped. Throwing it up first adds time.

dimension-mismatch.text: Check the unit: the answer is a time.

generic.text: Use s = ut − ½gt² with s = −h, and take the positive root.

ignores-launch-height.front: Ball thrown up from a cliff top: time to the ground below?
ignores-launch-height.back: Solve h + ut − ½gt² = 0 with the cliff height; 2u/g only brings it back to the top.

ignores-throw.front: Thrown up from a cliff vs dropped: same time to land?
ignores-throw.back: No. The upward throw adds time going up and coming back.

generic.front: Thrown up from a cliff: time to land?
generic.back: Solve −h = ut − ½gt² and take the positive root.

accessibility.altText: A ball thrown upward from the top of a cliff.
accessibility.nonDragAlternative: Use Play and the time slider; type your answer in the box.
